regions.summary: Advance the frame counter, update player and objects, and run palette fade in sound PRG pair 12/13 inherited from the frame contract. While active, also draw random transition decorations. After the high frame count reaches one, choose the next stage transition or return to the opening for the final stage. Disable rendering/NMI at vblank and advance the stage index. Reset stage/scroll/object/player state and load stage resources. Ordinary stages install gameplay state three; stage seven instead copies its scene nametable, initializes the later ending scripts and selects frame state $0F before re-enabling NMI. Disable rendering/NMI at vblank, select menu CHR banks and clear the nametable. Draw the continue text, initialize the literal-sprite cursor and selected option, queue music $37 and upload its palette, then enable NMI in menu state nine. Draw the menu cursor. Select toggles the choice and requests sound two; Start either returns to opening or resets score, stage/object state and life count, queues continue sound and selects gameplay initialization. Stage seven uses the alternate initializer. Disable rendering/NMI at vblank, clear the screen and draw the status-card text. Publish stage and lives as tile indices, clear the frame timer, select state $0B and re-enable NMI. After $60 low-counter ticks, disable rendering at vblank and initialize gameplay resources/scroll. Stage seven enters alternate gameplay; ordinary stages reset pools and select state three. Re-enable NMI on return. Read little-endian pointers from (work2),Y until $FFFF. Each target contains a little-endian PPU destination followed by tile bytes ending in $FF. Reset the PPU latch for each block and write the stream directly while rendering is disabled.

regions.summary: Scan twenty nine-byte secondary projectiles for an eight-pixel square overlap with this effect. Remove the first hit projectile and set carry; exhausting the pool clears carry. Queue a hit sound selected by hitbox class, award score using the low five kind bits, and choose extra-flag, removal, or ordinary death behavior. Kind $13 additionally looks for three consecutive free slots before attempting the special split setup. Set state eight and fixed death movement/animation pointers, clear transient motion fields and choose whether the death object follows scroll from the stage-script state. Search stride-21 object slots for three consecutive zero-state slots up to offset $93. Return carry set for a free run, with the first slot reference retained; encountering an active state starts a later candidate and exhausting the scan clears carry. Install fixed movement/animation scripts, metasprite $2B, kind $15 and health three. Clear Y velocity and use the common transient-field reset; the encoded conditional branch is retained even though the immediate zero makes it untaken. Set state $80 and kind $17, install fixed scripts, advance the metasprite, choose hitbox two/direction $0C and upward velocity $FE. Rejoin the common transient reset; the following alternate entry is independently supported. Initialize the parent death scripts, queue sound $10, and allocate up to five secondary projectiles from four-byte templates at the parent position. Each starts with movement countdown/interval one and cleared terrain response; a full pool truncates allocation. Initialize parent death scripts and sound, find its auxiliary link record, remove the companion object and retain the link parameter for the projectile burst. No matching link returns without a burst. Allocate up to five secondary projectiles using one of two direction tables chosen by the saved link parameter. Copy parent position, set draw ID $3D and initialize movement counters. The encoded loop advances Y after its doubled lookup index; exact emitted order is preserved. Clear X velocity, scratch/repeat/movement/animation counters and extra flags for the current primary object. Y velocity is deliberately left to the caller. Only proceed when the slot search returned carry set. Populate three stride-21 slots at the parent position with fixed scripts, state one, kind/health two, zeroed motion and per-slot local directions. Exact enemy presentation remains tentative. Award stage/half-dependent score, clear ordinary object states while preserving an attached accessory slot, and install a series of fixed death animations around the defeated object. Stage two uses per-object delay data instead of coordinate offsets. Finally allocate a transition object from the fixed initialization record chosen by coarse scroll. Use the object extra flag to select a four-byte movement/animation pair from the alternate definition table in PRG pair 2/3. Guard both MMC1 transactions against the interrupt, set state four and reset transient fields, then restore the stage resource PRG payload. Effective physical bank identity differs from that payload.
